candidateRepairPreflight.scope: Every number names the company, internal population and August 2026 timing.
candidateRepairPreflight.autonomy: The article defines recursive self-improvement in plain language and distinguishes it from supervised bounded work; Anthropic says no measured subset was fully autonomous.
candidateRepairPreflight.limits: Both reports are identified as preliminary internal measurements with different methods.
candidateRepairPreflight.consumerBoundary: The article says this is not a change to an everyday ChatGPT or Claude account.
candidateRepairPreflight.budget: All visible source-derived wording and claim limitations are charged conservatively: 189/200 Anthropic and 153/200 OpenAI. One quoted provider label word remains below the 25-word quotation limit.

draftArchitecture.openingJob: Give the two concrete internal measurements, then say immediately that they concern supervised frontier-lab work.
causalSequence: A human sets a research question, constraints and success conditions.
Agents execute bounded coding, experiment or analysis tasks, sometimes in parallel.
A human reviews the evidence, redirects when needed and judges which result matters.
People retain authority to scale, pause, deploy or choose the next research direction.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A researcher delegates an eight-hour debugging or experiment task, reviews the results and decides whether it changes the research plan.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: For another automation statistic, ask what unit of work was measured, what decision rights remained human and whether an outside party checked it.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Ask: Which work was counted? What did the human still decide? Was the measure independently checked?
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: The Story; LAiDIES Read; What This Means for You; Cocktail Party; Class Notes.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: No robot-takeover hook, no claim of RSI, no consumer-product advice and no unscoped percentage.

analogyPlan.analogy: Delegating a complex assignment does not hand over company strategy or approval rights.
analogyPlan.mapping: The human sets the outcome and standards; the delegate completes bounded work; the human evaluates and decides what happens next.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: Makes the difference between executing a task and owning strategy or approval rights familiar.
analogyPlan.limit: The lab workflow is more technical and multi-agent; the analogy covers decision rights only.

humourPlan.noneReason: The autonomy distinction needs precision more than a joke.
